MedTech supply chain consultancy

Improve flow without weakening the control environment.

Evidence-led diagnostics for UK MedTech and regulated distribution leaders who need a defensible account of service, inventory and operational risk.

When the measure itself must stand up to challenge

In regulated supply chains, a weak baseline does more than waste time. It can direct corrective action at the wrong cause and create a traceability problem alongside the original non-conformance.

Phull Insights separates service failure, planning variation, control time and avoidable waiting—without crossing into clinical, quality or regulatory decision-making.

Typical questions

  • Is OTIF measuring the agreed customer and product reality?
  • Where are controls working, and where are surrounding hand-offs adding delay?
  • Which SKU, supplier or customer segments create disproportionate complexity?
  • What evidence is strong enough to support corrective action?

Read the regulated MedTech case study

Useful starting evidence

  • Order, promise and delivery events
  • Customer-class lead-time definitions
  • Inventory and SKU segmentation
  • Exception and release states
  • Approved operational assumptions
